name: Avout
long_description:
Avout finances equipment for physical AI companies, starting with robot fleets, data centers, and data receivables.

Hardware startups pay for machines with venture equity, the most expensive money they'll raise. We package each deal so lenders can price it, match it to the right fund, and run it to close. Every deal adds to the record of how these machines perform, default and recover, which no lender has today.

We have 3 live deals for $7, $10M in LOIs from capital providers, and our first $1.5M term sheet for a data center company. 

Artem founded FarmTogether (YC W'18 accepted) and made farmland investable: $220M across 50 deals and 2,000 investors. FarmTogether is acting as our first capital partner where it has access to 40,000 potential investors (HNWI, FO, RIAs). Before that he invested at Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan. Cody built banking and payments systems at Interac, Moneris and TD Bank.
one_liner: Financing the physical buildout of the American frontier
